# Bridge protocol

The Bridge protocol is the HTTP protocol between Muster and a bridge, the separate service through which
Muster delivers Alert Groups to a messenger it has no native support for: Muster calls the bridge to post, edit
and reply, and the bridge reports presses, Thread messages, Account link requests and deleted messages back.

This is version `1.0.0` of the protocol. Every path is under `/v1/`, and a bridge reports `protocol_version`
`"1"` in its answer to `GET /v1/info`. New optional fields and features keep version 1; a change that breaks
existing bridges gets a new major path. The protocol is published under the MIT licence, so a bridge may stay
closed.

- The [Bridge protocol reference](bridge/spec/index.html) is rendered from `api/bridge.yaml`,
  the OpenAPI document of the protocol, so it describes the protocol this version of Muster speaks.
- The specification itself, as a raw file, is
  [`api/bridge.yaml` on `master`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muster-io/muster/master/api/bridge.yaml).
- [Write a bridge](../messengers/write-a-bridge.md) is the guide: the bridge libraries first, then the protocol
  step by step.
